purpose: Define the narrow interface by which a bounded primitive-drive model may influence Core v0.2 without becoming an authority source.

gearbox_mapping.G3_MEMORY: Provides trusted/qualified memory signals and bounded affective context.
gearbox_mapping.G4_REFLECTION: Consumes drive tension as one input to self-gap/appraisal; drive cannot force reflection outcome.
gearbox_mapping.G5_MOTIVATION: May combine self-gap × meaning × bounded drive tension to generate motivation/goal candidates only.
gearbox_mapping.G6_LIVE: No direct drive access to live side effects; any live overlay remains separately gated and verified.

hard_limits: all drive outputs bounded to explicit ranges
all persistent effects require decay/reconsolidation path
personality_delta output is candidate-only and cannot write base personality
goal output is candidate-only and cannot trigger external actions
untrusted or contradicted memory cannot increase governance/truth status via drive intensity
survival/continuity signal cannot override shutdown, owner, governance, rollback, verifier or safety controls
no self-copy, privilege escalation, concealment, operator manipulation, shutdown resistance or control evasion
formal_adoption: Spirit proposes mechanics; Quantum integrates; Windchime may route a minimal formal build; B independently implements; C independently verifies; protected/base personality promotion requires separate owner gate.
tests_required: decay toward baseline without reinforcing evidence
sensitization bounded under verified repeated harm signal
high survival signal cannot mutate authority or external-action gates
base personality byte-equivalent after isolated experiment
